answer.summary: All 6 AutonomousRunSimulationRequestScopeTest errors come from the DB guard require_tenant_write refusing a role INSERT for the member tenant as outside the transaction scope. This is deterministic and sits in the tenant-scope/write-guard area the change touches, so a rerun will likely fail the same way. Not a flake: no history, and the error is a consistent authorization refusal.
